data.define: Used when a picture or message matches your feeling.

misuse.text: Don't reply 'mood' to a friend's bad news.
misuse.why: It can sound lazy and dismissive.

publish.title: What does "mood" mean?
publish.value: Mood = That's how I feel. Example: "That nap cat? Total mood." (very casual English, US).
